what_to_detect: A resolution exiles a permanent that would return to the battlefield, the card is an instant or sorcery card, and no zone_change from exile to the battlefield follows for it: it stays in exile.
near_miss: The same exile-and-return resolution on a permanent card, which does return to the battlefield.
record_fields: payload.events zone_change battlefield to exile and the missing exile to battlefield
gen-3 card real_face and face_state of the face-down permanent
the exiled card's types in the next record's snapshot

what_to_detect: A static ability's contribution of an ability to a permanent that it already granted to that object while it was a spell on the stack.
near_miss: A permanent spell the static did not grant the ability to enters without the ability.
record_fields: the same entity's zone stack in an earlier continuous record's contributions
gen-3 card history entered this turn

what_to_detect: A prevention effect whose chosen source was a permanent spell on the stack prevents damage dealt by the permanent that spell became.
near_miss: Damage from a permanent that was not the shield's chosen source meets the effect and is not prevented.
record_fields: gen-3 command floating_effects remembered (the chosen source)
the source's zone stack in the snapshot when the shield was created

what_to_detect: An ability of a permanent whose condition reads how the spell it was got cast (a kicker or alternative cost paid, mana spent) resolves with that condition met.
near_miss: The same ability where the spell was cast without that cost: its condition is not met (or, for an intervening-if trigger, it does not fire).
record_fields: gen-3 card lines cast_with on the permanent
trigger record fired for a ValidCard$ Card.Self+kicked trigger

what_to_detect: A spell with an additional cost that moves an object (sacrifice, discard) whose effect then uses information about that object (power, mana value); the cost half and effect half share a link_id.
near_miss: The same spell was countered: the cost half exists and the effect half does not.
record_fields: payload.events (damage_dealt amount in the resolution half)

what_to_detect: A resolution whose first part moves an object and whose later part uses a characteristic of the moved object (Reanimate losing life equal to the returned card's mana value).
near_miss: The same effect when its moved object is gone before the later part; the later part has no event.
record_fields: payload.events (zone_change then life_change/damage_dealt in one resolution half)
